notes: 힌트 URL(Trion-480, 남아공 Enviro Bio-Chem, 480g/L SC)은 완전히 다른 제조사·제형으로 성분(농도)/제품유형 불일치. 실제 제품은 Syngenta EPA Reg No. 100-1264 '0.25% Mesotrione on Fertilizer'(과립형 비료+제초제 배합)로 확인되었으나 대체 SDS(Section 11 포함)를 찾지 못함

정식 SDS(GHS Section 11) 못 찾음(EPA 등록취소 2014년, Thor GmbH). 성분은 EPA 라벨 기준 Diuron 15%, 3-Iodo-2-propynyl butylcarbamate 10%, Octhilinone(2-n-Octyl-4-isothiazolin-3-one) 7.5%로 일치 확인(Dodecyltrimethylammonium chloride는 라벨상 'Other Ingredients'에 포함 추정). 라벨상 신호어는 DANGER(구형 FIFRA 라벨, GHS H코드 없음)
GF-1983는 Corteva 내부코드로, 동일 성분(spinosad 80%, kaolin, di-2-ethylhexyl sodium sulfosuccinate, amorphous silica, TiO2)의 Entrust NATURALYTE INSECT CONTROL SDS로 확인. 눈자극 구분은 시트상 2A(제공된 힌트 2B와 소폭 차이)

toxicity.ghs_hazard_statements: H319 (Causes serious eye irritation); combustible dust hazard statement (may form combustible dust concentrations in air)

toxicity.acute_dermal_toxicity_ld50: spinosad LD50 Rabbit > 5,000 mg/kg; di-2-ethylhexyl sodium sulfosuccinate LD50 Rabbit male > 10,000 mg/kg; amorphous silica LD50 > 2,000 mg/kg (estimated); TiO2 LD50 Rabbit 10,000 mg/kg
toxicity.acute_inhalation_toxicity_lc50: spinosad LC50 Rat 4h > 5.18 mg/L (no acute inhalation toxicity); amorphous silica LC50 Rat 4h > 2.08 mg/L; TiO2 LC50 Rat male 4h > 6.82 mg/L
toxicity.skin_corrosion_irritation: spinosad/kaolin/amorphous silica/TiO2: no skin irritation (rabbit); di-2-ethylhexyl sodium sulfosuccinate: skin irritation
toxicity.eye_damage_irritation: Category 2A; spinosad/kaolin/TiO2: no eye irritation (rabbit); di-2-ethylhexyl sodium sulfosuccinate: corrosive to eyes
toxicity.respiratory_skin_sensitization: spinosad: no skin sensitization (guinea pig); di-2-ethylhexyl sodium sulfosuccinate: no skin sensitization (human); TiO2: no contact allergy/skin sensitization in mice/guinea pigs; no respiratory sensitization data
toxicity.germ_cell_mutagenicity: spinosad/amorphous silica: negative in vitro & animal studies; di-2-ethylhexyl sodium sulfosuccinate & TiO2: mixed (negative in some, positive in other in vitro studies)
toxicity.carcinogenicity: spinosad/kaolin: did not cause cancer in animals; amorphous silica: no significant human cancer risk; TiO2: lung tumors/fibrosis in rat inhalation overload studies, not carcinogenic in feeding studies, no unusual cancer incidence in exposed workers
toxicity.reproductive_toxicity: spinosad: effects on reproduction only at maternally-toxic doses, no birth defects; di-2-ethylhexyl sodium sulfosuccinate: no interference with reproduction (data inadequate for teratogenicity); amorphous silica: no birth defects/fetal effects
toxicity.stot_single_exposure: Not classified as STOT-SE toxicant for any listed component

toxicity.aspiration_hazard: kaolin/di-2-ethylhexyl sodium sulfosuccinate/amorphous silica/TiO2: not likely aspiration hazard; spinosad: could not be determined

notes: 성분조합(에폭시수지, 용제나프타, 자일렌, 이소부탄올, 인산아연, 에틸벤젠, 요소포름알데히드수지, 감마-사이할로트린)에 부합하는 SDS를 찾지 못함. "GF-231"은 다른 회사(General Formulations)의 필름/라미네이트 제품명과 동명이라 검색 혼선이 있었음 - 해당 제품은 무관함
